answer_1.quote: Large language models (LLMs) have the potential to be trained as specialized role-playing agents (RPA). Users provide a predefined character profile to stimulate the RPA's human-like simulation abilities. The RPA's responses include the expected character style, knowledge, or behavior...
answer_1.outputs: Character-specific responses to queries containing knowledge errors

answer_2.quote: Accuracy is the ratio of yes responses over all queries three times along with the standard error of the mean (SEM).

answer_3.quote: Inspired by the 'LLMs as Judges', we provide LLM as evaluator. The evaluator takes the open-ended responses of the LLMs when playing a specific character, along with the memory modification explanations, as input, and assesses whether the LLM correctly identifies (for KKE) or expresses doubt/refuses (for UKE) the character error in the query.
